generic_domain.justification: Grid-based representations are a fundamental framework in deep learning that allows data to be structured into regular, often regularly spaced grids, such as images and spatio-temporal sequences. This domain encompasses both grid-based and grid-like representations by providing the foundational structure upon which more complex or modified approaches can build. Grid-like representations might involve variations or extensions of grid structures but ultimately still rely on the underlying principles established in grid-based frameworks.
